text:
maria: Quick sync — CI started spitting a bunch of low-confidence findings for auth-service (mostly generated protobufs and third-party deps). Thinking we need a suppression policy + a compact review/approval workflow. Anyone object?

kevin: can you paste an example of the finding (path + rule id)?

scanner-bot: Scan report: 12 findings (9 low, 3 medium). Full report: https://scans.internal/reports/1748765432

maria: paste from report:
```
/path/to/auth/generated/*.pb.go: INFO: rule ID S001 - insecure-rand: 0 occurrences (false positive from codegen)
/vendor/github.com/third/oldpkg/foo.go: LOW: rule ID S210 - weak-crypto: usage of MD5 in test helper
```

kevin: looks like classic codegen + vendor noise. Proposal: per-repo suppression files under `.security/suppressions.yaml` + path glob capability. Global suppressions only for infra-wide issues.

james: +1 but we need to lock who can add global suppressions. Suggest RBAC change: only `security-leads` and `engineering-managers` can approve global entries. Also audit log every suppression add/remove.

maria: Agreed. Also want the suppression file to be signed so CI can verify it wasn't tampered with. Idea: sign suppression manifests with KMS key `projects/redwood/keys/suppression-signing` and store signature in the PR.

tara: From compliance/Legal: we need an immutable audit trail for suppressions and reasons. Retention policy? Recommend 3 years min. Also notify `#compliance` channel on global suppression.

oliver: On the infra side I'll wire audit logs to `prod-audit` index: fields: `actor`, `scope` (repo|global), `reason`, `rule_ids`, `signature`, `proof_url`. We can also store the KMS key id used for signing.

kevin: For CI gates: validator script will verify signature via KMS public key and ensure approvals >=2 for repo-level suppressions, and require security lead sign-off for global. Also disallow bypass on protected branches.

maria: Can someone open a short RFC in `eng-security` board with the policy text and examples? I'll draft a first pass. Tagging: @kevin @james @tara @oliver

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll add unit tests for the validator, and a small `ci/verify_suppressions.py` hook.

scanner-bot: Created ticket SECURITY-5422: "Suppression governance + audit/signing" and assigned to `maria`.

maria: thanks — if we can land RFC this week we can iterate quickly. I'll include a migration plan to convert existing suppressions into signed manifests.

james: FYI: DAST runs should respect repo suppressions but we should not allow DAST skip tokens without explicit approval. Documenting this in the RFC.

kevin: ok let's sync tomorrow 10am to finalize RBAC groups and KMS key perms.

maria: done. Meeting invite sent. -- maria
